summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing the notice of its annual and special shareholders meeting and management information circular. The document covers routine agenda items: receiving audited financial statements, electing seven directors, appointing auditors, an advisory vote on executive compensation, and approving an amendment to extend the omnibus incentive plan to its tenth anniversary. The meeting is scheduled for July 30, 2026, to be held virtually. This is a standard proxy circular for an annual meeting and does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. Accordingly, the filing is classified as None for special situations.
